LAW_PRESERVATION.CLAUSE_197: Post-barrier Chats may still join for closure, review, audit, and read-only verification.
LAW_PRESERVATION.CLAUSE_200: Every current-epoch normal membership record remains included in the closure membership manifest.
LAW_PRESERVATION.CLAUSE_217: Every Chat still creates or renews a real sharded membership record. No observer bypass namespace exists in V2.
LAW_PRESERVATION.CLAUSE_215: Final COMPLETE still uses expected-version Mission Fence CAS.
LAW_PRESERVATION.CLAUSE_216: Any membership-universe change after pin first linearizes REOPEN through Mission Fence before its membership write can become canonical.

AUTHORITATIVE_SHARD_STATE.CAS_LAW: Every normal membership create, renew, suspend, retire, revoke, or other record mutation in the shard and every shard freeze transition are serialized through the same authoritative shard CAS domain. A successful operation must bind EXPECTED_SHARD_STATE_VERSION and write SHARD_STATE_VERSION = expected + 1 atomically with the canonical record-set change or freeze-state change.
AUTHORITATIVE_SHARD_STATE.TRANSPORT: SINGLE_REF_COMPAT may realize this as one expected-head Git CAS containing both shard-state and affected membership-record mutation. SHARDED_REF_SCALE must use one authoritative shard ref/CAS domain per logical membership shard. TRANSACTIONAL_CONTROL_STORE may use an equivalent serializable transaction. Separate unbound acknowledgement files are insufficient.

CLOSURE_ENTRY: Mission Fence expected-version CAS closes WORK_ADMISSION_GATE, MUTATION_GATE, and INTEGRATION_GATE.
The same Mission Fence CAS increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH exactly once for closure entry and increments CLOSURE_GENERATION exactly once.
The same entry establishes CLOSURE_STATE = MEMBERSHIP_FORMING.
No product mutation or target integration is eligible after this linearization point.
MEMBERSHIP_FORMATION: Every participating Chat obeys clause [217] and holds a real sharded membership record.
During MEMBERSHIP_FORMING, closure-only/read-only membership joins or renewals may occur through the shard CAS domain.
Before freeze begins, each admitted membership mutation updates the shard RECORD_SET_ROOT_HASH in the same shard CAS transaction.
ATOMIC_SHARD_FREEZE: For every logical shard in SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH, including empty shards, execute a shard CAS from MODE=OPEN to MODE=FROZEN for the active CLOSURE_GENERATION.
The freeze CAS increments SHARD_STATE_VERSION and FREEZE_GENERATION and binds an immutable FROZEN_SNAPSHOT_ID plus exact RECORD_SET_ROOT_HASH.
A membership writer that read an earlier OPEN shard state must present the earlier SHARD_STATE_VERSION; after freeze its CAS fails.
A writer that reads MODE=FROZEN cannot perform a normal membership mutation while the current closure pin remains valid.
No freeze acknowledgement is authoritative unless it is derived from the successful shard freeze CAS result itself.
CLOSURE_STATE may advance from MEMBERSHIP_FORMING to MEMBERSHIP_FROZEN only after every shard has a valid FROZEN state for the same CLOSURE_GENERATION and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH.

PINNED_WORLD_BINDING.MANIFEST_SOURCE: Build the clause [200] membership manifest only from the immutable FROZEN_SNAPSHOT_ID of every shard. Build the drain manifest from the same closure generation and include explicit empty shards.
PINNED_WORLD_BINDING.MISSION_FENCE_BINDING: Before sweeps, a Mission Fence expected-version CAS sets CLOSURE_STATE = PINNED_WORLD_READY and binds an immutable CLOSURE_BINDING_HASH over CLOSURE_GENERATION, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, SHARD_UNIVERSE_HASH, SHARD_FREEZE_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH, MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH, DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH, and every other clause [209] pinned-world component.
PINNED_WORLD_BINDING.EFFECT: After PINNED_WORLD_READY, normal membership-shard states for that closure generation remain FROZEN until a Mission Fence REOPEN linearization invalidates that pinned closure generation.

POST_PIN_JOIN_AND_MEMBERSHIP_MUTATION: Clause [197] remains usable: a post-barrier Chat may request to join for closure/review/audit/read-only work, but clause [217] still requires a real membership record.
While Mission Fence CLOSURE_STATE is PINNED_WORLD_READY, SWEEP_1, SWEEP_2, or COMPLETE_CAS_PENDING, no normal membership create/update may be admitted directly to a frozen shard.

Before any such membership mutation can become canonical, the requester or control participant must execute a Mission Fence expected-version CAS from the active pinned closure state to REOPEN_REQUIRED.
That REOPEN CAS increments Mission Fence STATE_VERSION and invalidates the prior CLOSURE_BINDING_HASH for completion.
If a concurrent COMPLETE CAS wins first, the REOPEN CAS fails and the membership mutation is not admitted into the terminated closure generation.
If the REOPEN CAS wins first, every concurrent COMPLETE CAS using the old expected Mission Fence STATE_VERSION fails.

Only after successful REOPEN may control create a new closure attempt/generation or reopen shard membership formation under a newly authoritative closure state, then admit the membership write through the shard CAS domain.
Therefore no post-pin membership mutation can commit while the old Mission Fence still authorizes COMPLETE against the old membership root.
FREEZE_JOIN_RACE_LINEARIZATION: If a membership write CAS wins before its shard freeze CAS, the freeze CAS fails on SHARD_STATE_VERSION and must retry from a state that includes the new membership.
If the shard freeze CAS wins first, the membership writer's stale expected SHARD_STATE_VERSION fails.

If a new join arrives after its shard is frozen but before global PINNED_WORLD_READY, the closure coordinator must REOPEN or abort the current freeze attempt before admitting the join; it may not mutate the frozen shard in place.
Thus every valid execution has exactly one ordering between membership mutation and shard freeze.
COMPLETE_LINEARIZATION: Immediately before COMPLETE, verify Mission Fence CLOSURE_STATE and exact CLOSURE_BINDING_HASH for the active CLOSURE_GENERATION.
Verify all shard states still reference the bound frozen snapshot generation and all clause [209] pinned-world components equal their bound values.
Execute COMPLETE as an expected-version Mission Fence CAS.

A post-pin membership request necessarily competes through the same Mission Fence CAS domain via REOPEN before any membership write; therefore the final COMPLETE predicate cannot be invalidated by a canonical membership write that is invisible to Mission Fence STATE_VERSION.
REOPEN_PROTOCOL: REOPEN_REQUIRED is an authoritative Mission Fence state, not advisory evidence.
A REOPEN transition invalidates the old pinned closure binding before any post-pin normal membership write is allowed.

Re-entering closure requires a fresh closure generation or equivalent new binding, re-freezing every shard including empty shards, rebuilding membership and drain roots, and rerunning required sweeps.
Old frozen snapshot artifacts remain immutable evidence but are noncanonical for the reopened closure attempt.
CRASH_RECOVERY: Crash before a shard freeze CAS commits: shard remains OPEN at prior authoritative version; retry safely.
Crash after shard freeze CAS but before global freeze aggregation: recover from authoritative FROZEN shard state; never infer from an acknowledgement file alone.
Crash after PINNED_WORLD_READY but before COMPLETE: recover from Mission Fence CLOSURE_BINDING_HASH and frozen shard snapshots; any mismatch forces REOPEN_REQUIRED.
Crash after REOPEN CAS but before membership write: old closure is already invalidated; membership write may be retried under the reopened authority without permitting stale COMPLETE.
Crash after COMPLETE CAS: mission terminal truth wins; uncommitted join or membership mutations from the old closure generation are rejected.
REQUIRED_TORTURE_TESTS: Writer reads OPEN shard state, pauses, shard freeze CAS commits, writer resumes: writer CAS must fail.
Writer CAS and shard freeze CAS race concurrently: exactly one wins at each shard version, with retry including canonical winner.
Post-pin join request races COMPLETE: join first means REOPEN CAS wins and COMPLETE fails; COMPLETE first means join REOPEN CAS fails and no membership write enters the completed generation.
Post-pin membership renew, suspend, retire, and revoke each require the same REOPEN-before-write rule, not only brand-new joins.
All 256 logical shards freeze, including empty shards; omit one empty shard and PINNED_WORLD_READY must fail.
Crash after shard freeze, after pin, after REOPEN, and immediately before COMPLETE.
High-concurrency membership storm during MEMBERSHIP_FORMING followed by freeze must produce deterministic canonical snapshot roots.
Attempt direct frozen-shard membership write without REOPEN must fail closed.
SAFETY_ARGUMENT: The original stale-completion execution requires a canonical membership change that can occur after the closer's last root read without touching the Mission Fence version. V2 removes that execution. Pre-pin membership writes serialize against shard freeze in the same shard CAS domain. Post-pin membership writes cannot occur until a REOPEN CAS changes Mission Fence STATE_VERSION and invalidates the pinned closure. Therefore either the membership change is included before freeze, or it invalidates the old closure before becoming canonical; it cannot remain invisible to the final COMPLETE CAS.
